description.value: Tsukiji Japanese Restaurant is a long-established Richmond dining room that has been serving traditional Japanese cuisine since 2003, built around a legacy of head chefs whose techniques continue to define the kitchen. The menu centres on sashimi prepared with ingredients imported daily from Japan, alongside 25+ varieties of aburi and nigiri, A5 wagyu beef, and an exclusive premium sake selection the restaurant claims is unavailable elsewhere in Vancouver. The site is also offered in Chinese, reflecting the multilingual community it serves.
